URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-job-growth-misses-expectations-june-unemployment-rate-falls-42-2026-07-02/

Reuters (BLS 13:30 BST): payrolls +57,000 June vs ~115,000 expected, slowest since February, prior two months revised lower. Unemployment fell to 4.2% because people left the labour force (WSJ: 'edged down to 4.2% as more people left the labor force' https://www.wsj.com/economy/jobs/june-jobs-report-unemployment-6c9540b6). Corroborated: Guardian https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/02/us-job-growth-slowed-june ; CNBC https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/02/jobs-report-june-2026-.html ; NBC https://www.nbcnews.com/business/economy/june-jobs-report-stable-hiring-rcna352603. Market effect (verified Yahoo/CNBC 19:15 BST): FTSE +1.67% to 10,653 two-month high; gold +1.0% 4,124; GBP 1.3348 +0.57%; Reuters: FTSE rally on softer US jobs calming rate fears. US 30-yr mortgage 6.43% 7-week low (AP).
